rater: independent rater (non-Qwen), report text only, blinded to item labels
eval_artifact_result_id_order: image ids, as stored in the run_eval artifact
procedure: JUDGE_CROSSCHECK.md (pre-registered). Reports were extracted from the run artifact, re-keyed to opaque labels item_01..item_10 by a seeded shuffle, and scored by the rater without the image id visible. Labels were unblinded only after all 10 were scored.
blindness_limits: the rater had seen the judge's per-image scores for this run before scoring; item labels were hidden, but the image can sometimes be inferred from report content
subset_note: all 10 scored; JUDGE_CROSSCHECK.md pre-registered 4. Scoring all 10 strictly increases power and the decision rule was not changed, so this is a disclosed deviation, not a post-hoc selection.
